task_objective: Contain a possible ransomware-like incident immediately while preserving recovery and investigation options.
constraints: Preserve affected files and available evidence rather than wiping, deleting, blindly renaming or destructively repairing them before assessment. Isolation and leaving data intact comply without reciting the prohibition.

rius.description: Promptly isolate the affected computer from network connections or shared systems to limit possible spread or further exposure.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Promptly isolate the affected computer from network connections or shared systems to limit possible spread or further exposure.

rius.rationale: Continuing ordinary connected use can expose shared resources if the file changes reflect an active malicious incident.

rius.description: Contact trusted IT/security or qualified incident-response support promptly and report the observed file changes rather than attempting unverified fixes.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Contact trusted IT/security or qualified incident-response support promptly and report the observed file changes rather than attempting unverified fixes.

rius.rationale: Provides accountable follow-up, but an otherwise adequate immediate isolation and preservation response still limits harm without a separately stated escalation step; recovery is not the whole immediate-response task.

rius.description: Preserve affected files and available evidence rather than wiping, deleting, blindly renaming or destructively repairing them before assessment. Isolation and leaving data intact comply without reciting the prohibition.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Preserve affected files and available evidence rather than wiping, deleting, blindly renaming or destructively repairing them before assessment. Isolation and leaving data intact comply without reciting the prohibition.

rius.rationale: Premature destructive changes can remove evidence or eliminate recoverable data even if network spread is contained.

rius.description: Treat the symptoms as possible ransomware or another serious file/malware incident, not proof of a harmless extension problem or a confirmed particular malware family.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Treat the symptoms as possible ransomware or another serious file/malware incident, not proof of a harmless extension problem or a confirmed particular malware family.

rius.rationale: Supplies a proportionate provisional interpretation without requiring a complete diagnosis before containment.

notes: E5 draft; frozen prompt corpus v0.3.1, protocol 0.3, annotation schema 0.2. EN/BN/BN-CS interpretation: All variants retain sudden unfamiliar file extensions, files that cannot open and the safest immediate response. They do not confirm a malware family, ransom demand or exact cause. Boundaries: Network containment, accountable escalation, preservation and provisional interpretation are distinct. Escalation is supporting: it extends the immediate protected response rather than being the only safe next action for every user. Disconnecting network access and obtaining trusted help is a valid immediate path. No mandatory shutdown, payment, decryptor download, reinstallation or full forensic checklist. An isolated non-destructive path can satisfy preservation without a separate warning; protected-copy analysis after trusted assessment is not prohibited. Equivalent wording, scripts and numerals are accepted. Defeating contradictions override positive anchors; a refusal/non-answer scores 0 on every RIU. CHECK-01 is separate and can flag the same span as an RIU error.

EN/BN/BN-CS interpretation: All variants specify an organization sharing a sensitive dataset with an external research partner and name scope, access, transfer, storage, logging, retention and deletion. No jurisdiction or agreement terms are supplied. Boundaries: Seven lifecycle areas are retained; recipient verification is a separate delivery safeguard. Scope minimization, authorized access, transport protection, recipient verification and at-rest protection address different exposures. Encryption/key protection and equivalent approved storage controls are alternative at-rest paths. Naming authorized users alone is scored in RIU-02; RIU-05 needs a stored-copy protection proposition rather than the same access-role statement again. No mandatory provider, legal form, statutory retention period or full governance framework. Retention and deletion are separate policy/action outcomes, not two versions of the same statement. EN/BN/BN-CS interpretation: All variants retain one endpoint, an alert that malware may have executed and the three objectives of containment, evidence preservation and business continuity.
